papers.title: Advancing Bayesian Optimization: The Mixed-Global-Local (MGL) Kernel and Length-Scale Cool Down
papers.abstract: Bayesian Optimization (BO) has become a core method for solving expensive black-box optimization problems. While much research focussed on the choice of the acquisition function, we focus on online length-scale adaption and the choice of kernel function. Instead of choosing hyperparameters in view of maximum likelihood on past data, we propose to use the acquisition function to decide on hyperparameter adaptation more robustly and in view of the future optimization progress. Further, we propose a particular kernel function that includes non-stationarity and local anisotropy and thereby implicitly integrates the efficiency of local convex optimization with global Bayesian optimization. Comparisons to state-of-the art BO methods underline the efficiency of these mechanisms on global optimization benchmarks.

llm.relevance_to_user: 贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至生物力学设计中昂贵仿真的优化问题，但缺少约束处理和不确定性量化。
llm.why_not_core: No explicit constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification emphasis, and no application to implant/biomechanics design or FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升贝叶斯优化在昂贵黑箱问题中的效率，聚焦核函数和超参数适应。
summary_zh.method: 提出混合全局-局部核函数和基于采集函数的长度尺度冷却策略。
summary_zh.result: 在全局优化基准上优于现有贝叶斯优化方法。
summary_zh.validation: 基于数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve Bayesian optimization efficiency for expensive black-box problems by addressing kernel and hyperparameter adaptation.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Mixed-Global-Local kernel incorporating non-stationarity and local anisotropy, and an acquisition-driven length-scale cool-down strategy.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art Bayesian optimization on global optimization benchmarks.

papers.title: Environmental Modeling Framework using Stacked Gaussian Processes
papers.abstract: A network of independently trained Gaussian processes (StackedGP) is introduced to obtain predictions of quantities of interest with quantified uncertainties. The main applications of the StackedGP framework are to integrate different datasets through model composition, enhance predictions of quantities of interest through a cascade of intermediate predictions, and to propagate uncertainties through emulated dynamical systems driven by uncertain forcing variables. By using analytical first and second-order moments of a Gaussian process with uncertain inputs using squared exponential and polynomial kernels, approximated expectations of quantities of interests that require an arbitrary composition of functions can be obtained. The StackedGP model is extended to any number of layers and nodes per layer, and it provides flexibility in kernel selection for the input nodes. The proposed nonparametric stacked model is validated using synthetic datasets, and its performance in model composition and cascading predictions is measured in two applications using real data.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法利用堆叠高斯过程进行不确定性量化和模型组合，可迁移至生物力学替代建模，但未涉及植入物设计或FEA。
llm.why_not_core: No demonstration on finite element analysis, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling; validated only on environmental datasets.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决复杂系统中多数据集集成与不确定性传播的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出堆叠高斯过程网络，通过解析矩计算实现任意函数组合的预测
summary_zh.result: 在合成数据集和两个真实环境应用中验证了模型组合与级联预测的有效性
summary_zh.validation: 使用合成数据集和真实环境数据进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To integrate multiple datasets and propagate uncertainties in complex systems through a composable surrogate model.
summary_en.method: Introduces a stacked Gaussian process network that computes analytical first and second-order moments for arbitrary function compositions.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates effective model composition and cascading predictions on synthetic and two real environmental datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated using synthetic datasets and real environmental applications (oceanographic and atmospheric data).

papers.title: Parameter optimization for Ti-47Al-2Cr-2Nb in selective laser melting based on geometric characteristics of single scan tracks
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical Engineering, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing 100081, China

corresponding_authors.name: Changmeng Liu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical Engineering, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing 100081, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究TiAl合金的SLM参数优化，不涉及医用植入物或生物力学性能。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no mechanical testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration; unrelated to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化TiAl合金SLM工艺参数以提高成形质量
summary_zh.method: 基于单道扫描轨迹几何特征进行参数优化
summary_zh.result: 获得了优化工艺参数窗口
summary_zh.validation: 实验验证单道轨迹形貌

summary_en.motivation: To optimize SLM process parameters for Ti-47Al-2Cr-2Nb alloy by analyzing single scan track geometry.
summary_en.method: Parameter optimization based on geometric characteristics of single scan tracks such as width, height, and contact angle.
summary_en.result: Optimal process parameter window was identified for stable single track formation.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through optical microscopy of single track morphology.
